Name: Easy ground
Author: anneV1310
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000][size=5]EASY GROUND
[/size][/color][/b][u][color=#616161]
[/color][color=#00ff00]This mod currently contains changes to spring and summer, as i feel they are the worst with the bright yellow tints. Due to a suggestion i have added an add-on for winter as well now.
[/color][/u][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]
[/size][/color][/b]This mod just turns the yellow-y shades of the rocks, dirt, grass into something that's easier on the eyes.
There's been plenty of mods like this, but I'm releasing one for 1.6.2 so it's fully up to date.

If there's any textures missing let me know I will fix it ASAP.
Enjoy
